Sun to Enter Virgo on September 17, 2026, Affecting Several Zodiac Signs

The Sun will transit into the Virgo zodiac sign on September 17, 2026, moving from its own sign of Leo. This astrological event, known as Kanya Sankranti, is expected to require caution for individuals born under specific zodiac signs. Navbharat Times reports that five zodiac signs, including Aries and Taurus, should be particularly vigilant regarding career and business matters. Aaj Tak highlights that three zodiac signs will face adverse effects from this transit.
